honesty_notes: A passing local test is not proof of production deployment.
A successful deployment is not proof that every feature works.
No live real-money settlement was performed; the demo is PayPal Sandbox.
The demo videos under docs/ are the project's own evidence; see docs/DEMO_EVIDENCE.md for what they do and do not establish.

The PayPal Sandbox credentials in the Vercel project are stored as `sensitive`, which the Vercel API cannot read back. The live PayPal order/authorize flow was therefore NOT re-executed by the documentation pass; it is evidenced by the project's own demo recording, the production health probe (paypal.mode=sandbox, settlement_is_real=true), and the PayPal client tests. A genuine end-to-end sandbox settlement remains a manual, credentialed step.
Production now serves the 190 kB code-split initial bundle (/assets/index-zW1Towtn.js, measured live, 2026-11-08) — PR #33 is deployed at 41958ab.

The genuine PayPal Sandbox order-creation path was verified against production on 2026-11-08: a real sandbox order was created and the run stopped at awaiting_approval (simulated=false, settlement_is_real=true). The interactive buyer approval and the resulting capture/refund were NOT driven remotely because they require a PayPal login; that portion remains evidenced by the project's own demo recording and the PayPal client tests.
